stemBlocks: An electric motor is connected to a constant $12\text{ V}$ d.c. supply. The motor is used to lift a mass of $20\text{ kg}$ by means of a rope and pulley. The mass is lifted vertically through a height of $6.0\text{ m}$ in a time of $5.0\text{ s}$. The complete lifting system (motor, rope and pulley) is $80\%$ efficient.
What is the current in the electric motor?
